# FG-GIT-0034

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `upload_pack_over_ssh_without_protocol_v2_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: SSH での clone・fetch には git のプロトコル v2 が必要です。git を 2.26 以降にするか git config --global protocol.version 2 を設定してください。
- en: Clone and fetch over SSH need git protocol v2. Use git 2.26 or later, or run git config --global protocol.version 2.
- id: Clone dan fetch melalui SSH memerlukan protokol git v2. Gunakan git 2.26 atau lebih baru, atau jalankan git config --global protocol.version 2.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C13 (ADR-0032 §3): `git-upload-pack` over SSH was asked without `GIT_PROTOCOL=version=2` (the SSH `env` request git sends through OpenSSH). forge serves SSH fetches through the same stateless upload-pack request as Smart HTTP (want check, confidential copy check, stream caps), which needs protocol v2's one-request-per-round shape; v0's stateful negotiation is not translated. Causes: git older than 2.26 without `protocol.version=2`, `protocol.version=0` in the client's configuration, or an SSH client git cannot pass the variable through (`GIT_SSH_VARIANT=simple`, plink). Push (`git-receive-pack`) has no v2 and is not affected.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One info log line `forge.ssh.command_refused` with `error_code=FG-GIT-0034`, `request_id`, `ssh_key_id`, `user_id`, `service=git-upload-pack` and `git_protocol` (the value received, empty when none). The client prints `fatal: remote error: FG-GIT-0034 … (request_id: …)`.

## 対処 (fix)

On the client: `git --version` (2.26 or later), `git config --show-origin protocol.version` (unset or 2), and an OpenSSH client (`GIT_SSH_COMMAND=ssh`). Or use the HTTPS clone URL.
